record.question: To blaze a trail.
record.explanation: Answer D: to initiate work. To blaze a trail means be the first to do something or initiate a course of work (D). Independent check: “Blaze a trail” means be the first to do something or create a new way; “initiate work” is the nearest option. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/blaze-a-trail. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
